summary.tagline: Møysalen National Park (Norwegian: Møysalen nasjonalpark) is a national park located on the island of Hinnøya

days.title: Eastern Peaks and Fjord
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Vestpollen
stops.detail: At the eastern foot of the mountain ends the fjord arm Vestpollen, the innermost part of the Øksfjord.

stops.name: Storsnytinden
stops.detail: In the eastern part of the park are the Storsnytinden (996 m) and the Nordtinden (883 m).

days.title: Møysalen Ascent and Northern Access
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Møysalen
stops.detail: In the center of the park stands the 1,262 m high Møysalen.

stops.name: Snytindhytta
stops.detail: A few kilometers north of the park lies the Snytindhytta tourist hut, which is connected to the park by a hiking trail at the E10.

stops.name: Nordbotn
stops.detail: On the Møysalen there are two marked hiking trails, one in the southwest, starting from Nordbotn, and one in the southeast, starting from the Vestpollen Fjord.
